evidence.result: Partial. 3 s sox envelope (1 s silence, -6 dBFS and -20 dBFS 1 kHz sines) to JSON and DAT at 480 samples per pixel, 16-bit: 300 pixels; silence 0, -6 dBFS max 0.501190, -20 dBFS max 0.100006; DAT payload equals JSON; PNG 300x200, alpha 0 to 255; reruns byte-identical. dat_header failed: DAT header version 1, plan expected 2.
evidence.scope: Fixture-reported: 3 s sox envelope, JSON/DAT peaks and length, DAT payload equal to JSON, PNG 300x200 alpha, reruns identical; dat_header failed (v1 not 2); macOS arm64

summary: Command-line tool producing waveform data and PNG waveform images from audio. It can create JSON for a downstream visualiser without requiring a browser to compute peaks.
use_when: Generate waveform data or stills from supported audio
Feed waveform data to a separate visualisation pipeline
avoid_when: Need onset or beat analysis: aubio or librosa
Need video or audio encoding: FFmpeg
